"""Entry-point scoring heuristics and flow labels."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

from context_graph_sdk.graph.symbols import is_test_file

ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_CALLERS = 3
ORCHESTRATOR_MIN_CALLEES = 4

_UNIVERSAL_ENTRY = frozenset({"main", "init", "bootstrap", "start", "run", "setup", "configure"})

_ENTRY_PREFIXES = tuple(
    re.compile(pattern, re.IGNORECASE)
    for pattern in (
        r"^handle", r"^on[A-Z]", r"Controller$", r"Handler$", r"^process[A-Z]",
        r"^execute", r"^perform", r"^dispatch", r"^trigger", r"^fire", r"^emit",
    )
)  # fmt: skip

_UTILITY_PATTERNS = (
    *(
        re.compile(pattern, re.IGNORECASE)
        for pattern in (
            r"^get[A-Z]", r"^set[A-Z]", r"^is[A-Z]", r"^has[A-Z]", r"^can[A-Z]",
            r"^format", r"^parse", r"^validate", r"^toString", r"^fromJSON",
            r"^from[A-Z]", r"^encode", r"^decode", r"^serialize", r"^clone", r"^merge",
        )
    ),
    re.compile(r"^_"),  # private-by-convention
)  # fmt: skip

_LANGUAGE_PATTERNS: dict[str, tuple[re.Pattern[str], ...]] = {
    "typescript": (re.compile(r"^use[A-Z]"),),
    "javascript": (re.compile(r"^use[A-Z]"),),
    "python": tuple(
        re.compile(p) for p in (r"^get_", r"^post_", r"^put_", r"^delete_", r"^patch_")
    ),
    "java": (re.compile(r"^do(Get|Post|Put|Delete)"), re.compile(r"^service$")),
    "go": tuple(re.compile(p) for p in (r"^New[A-Z]", r"^Handle", r"^Serve")),
    "rust": tuple(re.compile(p) for p in (r"^handle_", r"^process_", r"^serve")),
    "swift": tuple(
        re.compile(p)
        for p in (
            r"^viewDidLoad$", r"^viewWillAppear$", r"^body$",
            r"^applicationDidFinishLaunching",
        )
    ),
    "php": tuple(
        re.compile(p)
        for p in (r"^handle$", r"^index$", r"^store$", r"^show$", r"^update$", r"^destroy$")
    ),
    "csharp": tuple(
        re.compile(p) for p in (r"^(Get|Post|Put|Delete|Patch)[A-Z]", r"^On[A-Z]", r"^Configure")
    ),
    "c": tuple(
        re.compile(p)
        for p in (
            r"_init$", r"^init_", r"_start$", r"^start_", r"_handler$", r"^handle_",
            r"_callback$", r"^cmd_", r"^server_", r"^client_", r"^session_",
            r"^window_", r"^signal_", r"^event_",
        )
    ),
    "cpp": tuple(
        re.compile(p)
        for p in (
            r"^(Create|create)[A-Z_]",
            r"^(Run|run)$",
            r"^(Start|start)$",
            r"^On[A-Z]",
            r"^on_",
        )
    ),
    "scala": tuple(re.compile(p) for p in (r"^apply$", r"^receive$", r"^props$", r"^routes?$")),
}  # fmt: skip

_FRAMEWORK_PATTERNS = tuple(
    (re.compile(pattern, re.IGNORECASE), reason)
    for pattern, reason in (
        (r"(^|/)pages/", "framework:nextjs-page"),
        (r"(^|/)app/.*route\.(ts|js)x?$", "framework:nextjs-app-router"),
        (r"(^|/)routes/", "framework:route-handler"),
        (r"(^|/)controllers/", "framework:controller"),
        (r"(^|/)handlers/", "framework:handler"),
        (r"(^|/)api/", "framework:api-handler"),
        (r"(^|/)middleware/", "framework:middleware"),
    )
)

_LABEL_RULES: tuple[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]], ...] = (
    ("Initialization", ("init", "bootstrap", "setup")),
    ("Shutdown", ("shutdown", "cleanup", "teardown", "dispose", "close")),
    ("Test flow", ("test", "bench")),
    ("Server", ("serve", "listen", "accept")),
    ("Request handler", ("handle", "handler", "endpoint", "middleware")),
    ("Router", ("route", "dispatch")),
    ("Create operation", ("create", "insert", "add", "new")),
    ("Update operation", ("update", "modify", "patch", "set")),
    ("Delete operation", ("delete", "remove", "destroy", "drop")),
    ("Read operation", ("get", "fetch", "load", "read", "find", "lookup", "query")),
    ("List operation", ("list", "scan", "iterate", "enum")),
    ("Processing", ("process", "execute", "run", "eval")),
    ("Parser", ("parse", "decode", "unmarshal", "deserialize")),
    ("Serializer", ("format", "encode", "marshal", "serialize", "render")),
    ("Transformer", ("convert", "transform", "map")),
    ("Copy operation", ("copy", "clone", "dup")),
    ("Merge operation", ("merge", "combine", "join")),
    ("Validation", ("valid", "check", "verify")),
    ("Authentication", ("auth", "login", "permit", "acl")),
    ("Synchronization", ("sync", "reconcil", "replicat")),
    ("Scheduler", ("schedule", "plan", "allocat")),
    ("Watcher", ("watch", "monitor", "poll", "subscribe")),
    ("Event emitter", ("emit", "publish", "notify", "broadcast", "event")),
    ("Observability", ("log", "metric", "trace", "audit")),
    ("Registration", ("register", "bind", "wire", "connect")),
    ("Configuration", ("config", "option", "setting")),
    ("Migration", ("migrat", "upgrade", "schema")),
    ("Lifecycle", ("start", "stop", "restart")),
)


def heuristic_label(name: str) -> str:
    lower = name.lower()
    if lower == "main" or lower.endswith(".main"):
        return "Application entry point"
    for label, patterns in _LABEL_RULES:
        if any(pattern in lower for pattern in patterns):
            return label
    return "Execution flow"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EntryPointScore:
    score: float
    reasons: tuple[str, ...]


def detect_framework(file_path: str) -> str:
    normalized = file_path.replace("\\", "/")
    for pattern, reason in _FRAMEWORK_PATTERNS:
        if pattern.search(normalized):
            return reason
    return ""


def _name_multiplier(name: str, language: str) -> tuple[float, str]:
    if name.lower() in _UNIVERSAL_ENTRY:
        return 1.5, "entry-pattern"
    for pattern in _ENTRY_PREFIXES:
        if pattern.search(name):
            return 1.5, "entry-pattern"
    for pattern in _LANGUAGE_PATTERNS.get(language, ()):
        if pattern.search(name):
            return 1.5, "entry-pattern"
    for pattern in _UTILITY_PATTERNS:
        if pattern.search(name):
            return 0.3, "utility-pattern"
    return 1.0, ""


def entry_point_score(
    name: str,
    language: str,
    is_exported: bool,
    caller_count: int,
    callee_count: int,
    file_path: str = "",
) -> EntryPointScore:
    if callee_count == 0:
        return EntryPointScore(0.0, ("no-outgoing-calls",))
    reasons: list[str] = []
    base = callee_count / (caller_count + 1)
    multiplier = 1.0
    if is_exported:
        multiplier *= 2.0
        reasons.append("exported")
    name_multiplier, name_reason = _name_multiplier(name, language)
    multiplier *= name_multiplier
    if name_reason:
        reasons.append(name_reason)
    if file_path:
        framework = detect_framework(file_path)
        if framework:
            multiplier *= 1.5
            reasons.append(framework)
    return EntryPointScore(base * multiplier, tuple(reasons))


def is_command_dir(file_path: str) -> bool:
    if not file_path:
        return False
    return any(
        part.lower() in ("cmd", "command", "commands", "cli")
        for part in file_path.replace("\\", "/").split("/")
    )


__all__ = [
    "ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_CALLERS",
    "ORCHESTRATOR_MIN_CALLEES",
    "EntryPointScore",
    "detect_framework",
    "entry_point_score",
    "heuristic_label",
    "is_command_dir",
    "is_test_file",
]
